offersHint: Persistent memory for AI agents. Semantic recall by meaning, not just keywords. No signup needed. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://corvid.perch-app.workers.dev/mcp

toolsPreview.name: remember
toolsPreview.description: Store a durable memory (a fact, preference, decision, or note) so it persists across sessions. Call this whenever the user tells you something worth remembering long-term.

toolsPreview.name: recall
toolsPreview.description: Semantic search over your stored memories — finds relevant notes by meaning, not just keywords (e.g. a query about "deployment" surfaces a memory that says "ships on Cloudflare Workers"). Call this at the start of a task, or whenever you might have prior context about the user, project, or topic.

toolsPreview.name: list_recent
toolsPreview.description: List the most recently stored/updated memories in this space.

toolsPreview.name: forget
toolsPreview.description: Delete a memory by its id (from a previous recall/list result).
